options.description: Reword SR-209: you approve nothing yourself and are asked, through the question tool, only when your intent is unclear or contradicts itself. Matches how the intent loop already works; SR-202 unchanged.
options.label: Unclear or contradictory (Recommended)

options.description: Keep SR-209 as is: you are asked only to settle contradictions. The intent loop's clarifying questions would then need to change, a larger change to the loop.
options.label: Contradictions only

options.description: Narrow SR-202 so the question tool is only for contradictions; same effect on the intent loop as keeping SR-209.
options.label: Reword SR-202 instead

payload.question: Two of your requirements disagree on when you get asked things. SR-209 (the judge approves on your behalf) says you are "asked only to arbitrate contradictory intent". SR-202 (plain-words access) and the intent loop have plumb ask you questions through the question tool whenever your intent is unclear. Which should SR-209 say?
